title: POPIA compliance pack questionnaire
description: Answers drive scripts/popia_pack.py. Draft output only: engineering and compliance guidance, not legal advice. See DISCLAIMER.md.

types.multiselect: List of values; options are suggestions, other values allowed
types.records: List of objects with the fields in item_fields

questions.prompt: Registered legal name of the responsible party
questions.help: Exactly as registered with CIPC, for example 'Example Lodge (Pty) Ltd'. s18(1)(b).

questions.prompt: Company registration number
questions.help: CIPC number, for example 2020/123456/07.

questions.prompt: Trading name (if different)
questions.help: Leave blank if you trade under the legal name.

questions.prompt: Physical address
questions.help: Street address of the responsible party. s18(1)(b).

questions.prompt: Postal address (if different)
questions.help: Leave blank if the same as the physical address.

questions.prompt: Website
questions.help: Main website, for example https://example.co.za.

questions.prompt: Head of the private body (CEO, MD, sole proprietor or partner)
questions.help: Under PAIA the head is the Information Officer by default unless the role is delegated.

questions.prompt: Information Officer name
questions.help: Must be registered on the Regulator's eServices portal before taking up duties (s55(2)).

questions.prompt: Information Officer email
questions.help: Use a role address such as privacy@yourdomain.co.za so it survives staff changes.

questions.prompt: Information Officer telephone
questions.help: A number that is answered during business hours.

questions.prompt: Deputy Information Officers
questions.help: Optional. Designated under s56. Register them on the eServices portal too.

questions.prompt: Products and services offered
questions.help: Plain description, for example 'online booking for guesthouses'.

questions.prompt: Types of data subjects
options: Business customers and their contact people
questions.help: Juristic persons (companies) are data subjects too.

questions.prompt: Categories of personal information collected
options: Device and online identifiers (IP address, cookie IDs)
questions.help: s18(1)(a). Only list what you actually collect. Each category must map to a purpose (s10).

questions.prompt: Sources other than the data subject (if any)
questions.help: For example booking platforms, credit bureaus, public records. s12, s18(1)(a).

questions.prompt: Special personal information processed
questions.help: s26. Leave empty if none. Biometrics include face matching, fingerprints and voice recognition.

questions.prompt: What do you use the special personal information for?
questions.help: Complete the sentence 'We use it to ...'.

questions.prompt: s27 ground for processing special personal information
questions.help: s27(1)(a) to (f). Consent must be explicit and separate. Get attorney review.

questions.prompt: Do you process personal information of children (under 18)?
questions.help: s34, s35. Ask yourself whether you collect DOB, school or grade, or whether the product appeals to young users.

questions.prompt: Youngest age of children whose information you process
questions.help: Used to design the age gate and consent flow.

questions.prompt: Describe how and why children's information is processed
questions.help: Plain language for parents and guardians.

questions.prompt: Purpose for the competent person consent wording
questions.help: Complete the sentence 'to process my child's personal information to ...'.

questions.prompt: How do you obtain competent person (parent or guardian) consent?
questions.help: s35(1)(a). For example a parent account with a separate consent step.

questions.prompt: Purposes of processing and their lawful basis
questions.help: s13 and s11(1). One row per purpose. Legitimate interest needs a balancing assessment.

questions.prompt: Which information is mandatory and which is voluntary?
What happens if someone does not provide the information?
questions.help: s18(1)(e). For example 'we cannot create your account'.

questions.prompt: Laws that authorise or require collection (if any)
questions.help: s18(1)(f). For example FICA or tax law. Leave blank if none.

questions.prompt: Electronic marketing channels used
questions.help: s69. Leave empty if you send no electronic marketing. Treat calls as s69 until a court decides otherwise.

questions.prompt: What goods or services will you market?
questions.help: Needed for Form 4 style wording.

questions.prompt: Do you rely on the existing-customer exception (s69(1)(b))?
questions.help: Only for your own similar products to customers whose details you got in a sale, with an opt-out at collection and in every message.

questions.prompt: Strictly necessary cookies
questions.help: Session, security and load-balancing cookies. Run scripts/site_check.py to list what the site actually sets.

questions.prompt: Analytics tools
questions.help: For example GA4, PostHog, Plausible. Gate behind consent.

questions.prompt: Marketing and advertising tools (pixels, tags)
questions.help: For example Meta Pixel, LinkedIn Insight. Load only after opt-in.

questions.prompt: Operators (vendors that process PI for you)
questions.help: s20, s21, s72. Include hosting, database, email, CRM, analytics, payments, support, AI APIs, agencies.

questions.prompt: Main hosting region
questions.help: For example 'AWS af-south-1 (Cape Town)' or 'Supabase eu-west-1 (Ireland)'.

questions.prompt: Countries personal information is transferred to
questions.help: s72, s18(1)(g). Include every operator country outside South Africa. Leave empty only if all processing stays in SA.

questions.prompt: Do you rely on consent (s72(1)(b)) for any cross-border transfer?
questions.help: A binding agreement (s72(1)(a)) is usually the better default.

questions.prompt: Purpose of the consent-based transfer
questions.help: Complete the sentence 'so that ...'.

questions.prompt: Does the product have AI features that process personal information?
questions.help: Chatbots, summarising, enrichment, scoring, voice agents.

questions.prompt: Describe the AI features in plain language
questions.help: Shown in the privacy notice.

questions.prompt: AI provider
questions.help: Also list it under operators.

questions.prompt: AI provider processing country
What does the AI do with user data?
questions.help: Complete the sentence 'uses an AI service to ...'.

questions.prompt: How long does the AI provider keep prompts and outputs?
questions.help: Check the provider's current retention settings.

questions.prompt: Do you make decisions with legal or substantial effect based solely on automated processing?
questions.help: s71. Credit, hiring, pricing, eligibility, fraud blocks.

questions.prompt: Describe the automated decisions and the s71(2) exception relied on
questions.help: Get attorney review.

questions.prompt: Do you record calls?
questions.help: Needs a notice at the start of the call (s18).

questions.prompt: Why are calls recorded?
questions.help: For example 'quality and training'.

questions.prompt: How long are recordings kept?
Data sets and retention
questions.help: One row per table, collection or system. Becomes the ROPA (s17) and retention schedule (s14).

questions.prompt: Summary of security measures
questions.help: s19. Plain language: encryption, access control, MFA, backups, monitoring, staff training.

questions.prompt: Email for data subject requests
questions.help: Often the same as the Information Officer email.

questions.prompt: Backup owner for data subject requests
questions.default: the Deputy Information Officer, or the head of the private body
questions.help: Someone who covers requests when the Information Officer is away.

questions.prompt: Where are requests logged?
questions.help: Keep dates, outcomes and who handled each request (DSP-04).

questions.prompt: Business days to acknowledge a request
questions.help: Acknowledge quickly, even before you verify identity.

questions.prompt: Records available without a PAIA request
questions.default: Our privacy notice, cookie notice and any information published on our website.
questions.help: PAIA s52. Records anyone can get without a formal request.

questions.prompt: Target days to respond to requests
questions.help: Aim for 30 days or less.

questions.prompt: Effective date of the documents
questions.help: YYYY-MM-DD.

questions.prompt: Notice version
questions.help: Increase on every change. Store consent against the version shown.

questions.prompt: How will you tell people about material changes?
questions.default: email and a notice on our website
questions.help: s18 openness.
